rounds.text: Nihar Info Global Ltd trades at a compelling discount, marked by a low price-to-earnings ratio of 7.38x [E1] and a price-to-book value of 0.75x [E2], with the stock priced at ₹ 4.90 against a book value of ₹ 6.53 [E2]. This valuation sits well below sector benchmarks, with the P/E at 9.86x compared to a sector median of 19.58x and P/B at 1x versus the sector's 2.01x [E6, E7]. Fundamental momentum is striking, evidenced by phenomenal compounded sales growth of 60% over 3 years and 181% over the trailing twelve months, alongside compounded profit growth of 97% over 3 years and 119% over the trailing twelve months [E14, E15, E16, E17]. Operational efficiency is improving as working capital requirements have dropped sharply from 133 days to 68.4 days [E44], and capital expenditure is largely complete with CWIP dropping to ₹ 0 Cr, signaling new capacity coming online [E34]. A discounted cash flow analysis highlights an intrinsic value of ₹ 27 per share, creating a massive margin of safety of 81.8% [E37, E38], while a reverse DCF indicates the current market price implies an unrealistic -4.7% earnings growth against a base case assumption of 18.0% [E39].
